assertions.assertion: The claim is for CPT code 93247.
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope.
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is required to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide further management.
A long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study was ordered.
The diagnosis codes I49.5, I48.91, and I49.9 support the documented recurrent arrhythmias.
The diagnosis codes support the need for correlation of clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
